{
  "answer": "# Packaged Runtime Consumption Validation Checklist

## Health & Connectivity
- [ ] Verify local peer health status (processes running, ports open, no restarts)
- [ ] Verify remote OAuth account is active and tokens are valid
- [ ] `curl` the `/v1/models` endpoint and confirm a 200 response with expected model list
- [ ] Confirm DNS resolution and TLS handshake to the runtime endpoint succeed

## Logs Validation
- [ ] Confirm runtime startup logs contain no ERROR or FATAL entries
- [ ] Verify request/response logs are emitted for each model call
- [ ] Check that log correlation IDs are present and consistent across upstream and downstream calls
- [ ] Validate log rotation is active and logs are written to the expected destination
- [ ] Assert that PII/sensitive fields are masked or redacted in logs

## Telemetry Validation
- [ ] Verify metrics endpoint (e.g., `/metrics`) is reachable and returns expected counters/gauges
- [ ] Confirm model invocation latency, throughput, and error-rate metrics are populated
- [ ] Check that distributed traces are captured and exported to the configured backend
- [ ] Validate telemetry labels/tags include runtime version, model alias, and environment
- [ ] Assert no missing or orphaned telemetry spans for alias routes

## Strategy C Alias Tests
- [ ] List all configured Strategy C aliases and confirm each maps to a valid model ID
- [ ] Invoke each alias via the runtime API and verify a successful response
- [ ] Validate that alias routing respects region/weights/fallback rules defined in Strategy C
- [ ] Confirm failover behavior: alias resolves to secondary model when primary is unavailable
- [ ] Verify that alias-specific headers/query parameters are propagated correctly
- [ ] Assert telemetry and logs for each alias show the expected `strategy=c` and alias name
- [ ] Test concurrent alias invocations to ensure isolation and no cross-alias contamination"
}
